title: Partner reports TV/web playback bootstrap failure

partner_report.symptom: Video player does not begin playback and remains in loading state
partner_report.expected_behavior: Player should initialize and start playback
partner_report.actual_behavior: Player container renders but bootstrap/playback never completes

environment.device: desktop web simulating TV playback flow

console_signals: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource

network_signals.timing_note: request stalled beyond client timeout threshold

likely_root_cause: Playback bootstrap dependency timed out before player initialization completed
repro_steps: Start the player in a fresh session
Inspect console and network panel during page load
Confirm timeout or stalled playback bootstrap request
recommended_partner_actions: Verify whether the failing playback bootstrap endpoint is reachable
Retry in a clean session and alternate network environment
Compare behavior with reduced page complexity or minimal embed setup
